description: Communes du périmètre technique BSA : gestion du risque inondation is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Context of flood risk management in the municipalities of the PAPI BSA technical area: Atlas of flood zones, PPRI, TRI, PCS (notified, ongoing...). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Municipalities within the BSA technical area: Flood Risk Management" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include tempête, crue, lutte contre les inondations, changement climatique, inondation, Risque naturel. The listing shows 2015-10-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
